title: Margins Real Estate ERP System
cardDesc: Complete Odoo ERP system built from scratch for a real estate developer — CRM, units, reservations, broker management, contracts, accounting, payment tracking, and QWeb reports.
description: I designed and developed the full internal Odoo ERP system for Margins Developments — a real estate company with multiple projects across Egypt. The system covers the company's entire operational workflow from lead capture to contract generation and payment tracking.
role: Senior Odoo Developer (Full ERP Build). I owned the full project: business requirements analysis, data model design, custom module development, views, automation rules, QWeb reports, access rights, and deployment support.
features: Real Estate CRM – lead capture, qualification, and nurturing pipeline
Sales pipeline – opportunity tracking and stage automation
Unit / Property management – types, floors, areas, pricing, availability
Reservation workflow – booking, approval chain, and confirmation logic
Broker / Agent management – commissions and performance tracking
Customer data management – contacts, preferences, interaction history
Contract generation – automated document creation and status tracking
Accounting workflow customization – payment terms and journal entries
Payment milestone tracking – automated reminders and progress monitoring
QWeb reports – contracts, receipts, unit sheets, sales summaries
Role-based access control and record-level security rules
Data migration and module inheritance from Odoo standard modules
impact: Replaced fragmented manual spreadsheet processes with a unified, automated digital ERP — reducing data errors, accelerating sales cycles, enabling accurate pipeline reporting, and providing management with real-time operational visibility.
